credits.title: Sevda
credits.overview: Successful real estate agent Sevda is on the verge of closing a major project in Istanbul. However, just before construction is set to begin, she encounters an unexpected obstacle: an old Ottoman cemetery and its elderly caretaker who refuses to leave.

credits.title: The Queen
credits.overview: The matriarch of a traditional Turkish family tries to stop her eldest daughter’s divorce, only to confront the shifting values within her own home.

credits.title: The Witch
credits.overview: During the period of the collapse of the Ottoman Empire, a woman who reluctantly went to a gloomy Istanbul mansion as a bride, and the mysterious owner of the mansion, will go on a journey to the dark secrets of the past together.

credits.title: Dilberay
credits.overview: Born into a poor family with eight children in Kahramanmaraş, Dilber Ay endured many sorrows and hardships in the life she began in a tent. credits.title: The Outcast
credits.overview: An expatriate in Turkey, Claire pays the services of a smuggler to flee the country with her only daughter, whose custody she has just lost. But he abandons them in a dilapidated house in the middle of the forest.

credits.title: Not Knowing
credits.overview: Selma and Sinan are a couple who now find it difficult to endure each other. At the end of high school, rumors start circulating about their son Umut, who is gay. While Selma and Sinan are trying to cope with their tiring marriage, Umut suddenly disappears.

credits.title: Adım Adım
credits.overview: The life of Şevket, a former ballet dancer, changes suddenly when his son Tolga leaves his visually impaired daughter Ayşen with him. Devoting himself to Ayşen, who embraces life through music, Şevket finds himself in the predicament of different lives on this journey of hope.
